name: superpowers-plus
description: Workflow orchestration wrapping superpowers — front-to-back feature-building, enhanced plan writing with the Living Document Contract, adversarial plan review, a wire-walk reachability gate, structured handoffs, a post-certification editorial pass, and the full bug-hunt, health-review, and performance-audit workflows (hunter methodologies + project health review + multi-lane performance review + cycle skills, all in one plugin)

interface.longDescription: Eighteen workflow skills that wrap superpowers into front-to-back workflows: brainstorming-enhanced (requirements-pinning brainstorm wrapper with self-brainstorm mode); editorial-pass (post-certification meaning-preserving legibility rewrite with closed remedies — accept or revert to certified text, verified hunk-by-hunk by an independent dispatch); build-robust-features (brainstorm + delegated design review + delegated planning + wire-walk final gate); design-review-cycle (adversarial design-doc review — runner pilot, mode-width independent review, findings ledger + batched user gate, conditional re-sweep, two-leg closure with cold reader + ledger verifier); wire-walk (operator-defined reachability gate — traces each user flow to code by file:line from its real cold-start state; any broken flow = not shipped); writing-plans-enhanced (subagent-proofing + Living Document Contract + an automatic, unprompted plan-review gate before commit); plan-review-cycle (adversarial multi-round plan review); handoff (structured context preservation); bug-hunter-exploratory / bug-hunter-holistic / bug-hunter-multipass / bug-hunter-differential (four correctness-only hunter methodologies); bug-hunt-cycle (parallel hunter dispatch + cross-validation + remediation plan); project-health-review (five-axis adversarial dispatch); health-review-cycle (validation + remediation plan around the five-axis review); performance-audit (multi-lane performance review with version-aware currency brief + execution-cost map); performance-audit-cycle (cross-validation + measurement-gated remediation plan around the performance review); and writing-skills-enhanced (wraps superpowers:writing-skills with this repo's reference discipline). All sibling skills, no cross-plugin runtime deps.
